changes: Replaced repeated upward arches with unequal descending boughs and clustered curtains; 14 actual crown tips receive short leafy leaders.
Narrow folded lanceolate leaves replace broad repeated fins.
Pinned structural roots and shared wind phase for branches and leaves.
H06 uses 720 surface-fitted tapered locks; continuous dark root to light tip; original published body geometry and skin weights preserved exactly.

geometry.note: Includes T02 procedural shoots/leaves and willow branches from captured runtime reports. Excludes imported horse/herder/T01/T02/rock meshes, shadows and visibility culling. Not a frame-rate benchmark.

limitations: T02 leaf placement is procedural art direction on the supplied branch mesh; source bare model is kept independently.
Plant groups represent visual morphology, not verified botanical species or habitat reconstruction.
H01/H02 concealed limbs reconstructed from painting; H04/H06 walk on two authored short routes. Unrestricted herd navigation, manual retopology and performance acceptance are separate work.
Winter is an open river with bank frost; there is no snow accumulation or ice / weather simulation.
Three-minute cycle is simulation time; very slow devices run it more slowly. Desktop / mobile visual and functional checks do not constitute 60 FPS acceptance.
Current, whitewater and wakes are procedural artistic animation, not a hydrodynamic solver. Wave phase speed is not a measured Yongding River discharge.
